chosen.premise: Clefairy is rarely seen—except on full-moon nights, when groups gather from all over to dance.
chosen.hook: Clefairy has one night when the entire species comes out.
chosen.visualIdea: Show a dark mountain transforming into a full-moon dance gathering, then vanishing at dawn.
chosen.note: A Clefairy-specific recurring event with strong Pokédex support: rarity sharply contrasts with full-moon gatherings from across the region.

candidates.premise: Moonlight makes Clefairy float without flapping, turning its faintly glowing wings into a levitation system.
candidates.hook: Clefairy can rise into the air without moving its wings.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom in on faintly glowing wings as Clefairy rises motionless through moonlight.
candidates.note: The no-flapping levitation is genuinely surprising and highly visual, but the broader claim that moonlight functions as a complete levitation system is partly interpretive.

candidates.premise: Clefairy's all-night full-moon parties end at dawn, when the exhausted Pokémon return home and sleep pressed together.
candidates.hook: Clefairy's legendary moon party has a surprisingly cozy ending.
candidates.visualIdea: Cut from energetic moonlit dancing to sleepy Clefairy nesting together in a quiet mountain.
candidates.note: The dance-to-nesting contrast is concrete and well supported, though “all-night parties” is an embellishment—the entries establish full-moon dancing followed by sleep at dawn.

candidates.premise: Seeing Clefairy dance beneath a full moon is said to bring happiness—but the event is extremely rare.
candidates.hook: A Clefairy dance is supposed to bring happiness, if you can find one.
candidates.visualIdea: Follow clues from an empty mountain to a brief full-moon dance, ending with a happiness reveal.
candidates.note: The happiness legend is distinctive, but the cited evidence supports the claim less directly than the strongest moonlit-gathering angles and does not specifically establish extreme rarity of the dance itself.

candidates.premise: Clefairy requires high friendship to evolve from Cleffa, but a Moon Stone evolves Clefairy onward.
candidates.hook: Clefairy's evolution path switches from friendship to a Moon Stone.
candidates.visualIdea: Display the evolution chain as two gates: a friendship meter, then a glowing Moon Stone.
candidates.note: A clear two-step evolution-rule contrast, but it relies on secondary-source evolution-method data and is more of a game mechanic than a surprising Clefairy story.

candidates.premise: Clefairy's cute looks make it popular with nearly everyone, yet its numbers are few and thieves may target show-offs.
candidates.hook: Clefairy's popularity is exactly what makes showing it off risky.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Clefairy gaining admirers, then cut to a spotlight and warning icons around a careless trainer.
candidates.note: The popularity-versus-rarity contrast works, but “exactly what makes showing it off risky” overstates the evidence; the Pokédex only warns that reckless display may attract thieves.

rounds.request: Stronger angles would need an even tighter, explicitly supported contradiction or mechanic—ideally one that combines Clefairy’s moonlight-dependent floating with the exact no-flapping detail without adding interpretive language.
